name: fine-print
description: A second reader that flags what you would miss in a wall of text.

watchFor.title: Watch for
watchFor.description: Topics Fine Print flags: cost, security, data-loss, irreversible, customers, assumptions. 'all' means every topic, 'none' turns checks off.

maxChecksPerSession.title: Max checks per session
maxChecksPerSession.description: Spend cap: how many small-model checks Fine Print may run in one session. 0 turns checks off.
